_about: Session workout icons: one per session, chosen for its main exercise, tinted with its modality's colour on every client. src/session_icon.py resolves a session's: an archetype's or the lead exercise's own `icon:`, else the lead exercise's category (`exercise_category_defaults`), else — when the session has no lead exercise to read, as an archived row — the archetype's category (`archetype_category_defaults`). A session with none draws its modality icon. tools/icons/gen_workout_icons.py draws each id for the web from tools/icons/workout_glyphs.py; iOS, the Apple Watch and the widgets use the `kettlebell` symbolset (ios/tools/make_kettlebell_symbol.py), Garmin its cat_kettlebell bitmap. `fallback` is the icon a platform without the asset draws instead.
